facts.text: Tonight is for the Wolfpack. Doug gets married tomorrow, so I am only pouring a few drinks. Just a few.
facts.why: Alan never says this. His roof toast is the wolf pack speech: 'I tend to think of myself as a one-man wolf pack.' The 'only a few drinks' line is invented.
facts.fix: I tend to think of myself as a one-man wolf pack.

fix_note.text: I tend to think of myself as a one-man wolf pack.

vibe.verdict: The suite, the receipt and the door hanger sell the morning after well, but the dishes lean on plain descriptions and a few notes are filler.

Swap 'Wolfpack buffet prawns' note slot for a blackjack chip garnish line, 'Eighty grand in chips'
